summary: Teacher labeling: bge fp32 logits over all sampled pairs, cached
description: Batch scorer mirroring rerank.py/rung2 exactly (fp32, max_length 1024, body[:2400]). Cache keyed (sha256(query), chunk_id) so reruns are incremental. GPU (3090) needs per-run owner permission — ask first, announce, release after; CPU overnight is the fallback path and must also work. Output: teacher_scores.parquet or jsonl beside pairs.

resolution.note: 12,655 teacher logits (10,825 train + 1,830 frozen-eval) on the 3090: 27 pairs/s fp32 at judged config (max_length 1024). Cache keyed (qhash, chunk_id); reruns incremental.
